purpose: Stage 0 of claude/extended-ai-profile-architecture-2026-09-27.md: do career facts, wishes and passive-search conditions in a profile cause hard rejects of ordinary relevant orders? Paired design: each profile has a base variant (skills/resources only) and a career variant (same skills + career context). Expected: career variant decision == base variant decision. Separate from frozen blind holdout-100 (SHA 53b5c423...), which is NOT modified.
